name: external_market_data_ingest_lq1679_20261109
comment: ANCHOR: LQ-20261107-1679 — the banned yfinance quote writer is removed from
scripts/external_market_data_ingest.py, not merely skipped. market_quotes took 583 yfinance rows in
two days (newest 14:24 ET 2026-11-09) against the operator price rule (Finviz fresh <=30 min, else
fresh Schwab/Alpaca/moomoo; never yfinance). The tests pin: no ingest_yfinance_quotes definition /
no yfinance import / no source='yfinance' call (AST); a Finviz miss is reported under
unpriced.no_quote and nothing is written for it; a dead tier routes nothing; and --quotes-yf
refuses with exit 2 instead of exiting 0 as a silent no-op. Synthetic symbols only; no DB, no
provider call (fakes), the CLI case exits before any I/O.
